articles.summary: 150053568350107_1556229986527283 feeds_service November 3, 2026 Day 2 of CNA West saw Cameco leaders sharing insights and perspectives focused on the future of nuclear energy in Western Canada. A big thank you to everyone who joined sessions featuring our CEO Tim Gitzel, President and Chief Operating Officer Grant Isaac, senior VPs Lisa Aitken and Liam Mooney, board member and Lac La Ronge Chief Tammy Cook-Searson and Kari Krueckl Lamont. We're also proud to be the presenting sponsor of tonight's Indigenous Ambassador Reception, bringing people together to connect, learn and strengthen relationships across our industry. Two down, one to go. 150053568350107_1555136136636668 feeds_service November 3, 2026 Our 2026 Community Tour took us to Pinehouse last week, where we connected with community members, shared Collaboration Agreement updates and welcomed more than 80 students to an afternoon workshop covering reclamation, exploration, career opportunities and more. We also had the chance to cheer on the Pinehouse Lakers football team during their playoff win, enjoy a delicious community meal and reconnect with friends old and new. We’re kicking things off at the trade show and opening reception today, with plenty more to come over the next three days. If you're attending this year's event, stop by the Cameco booth, say hello to our team and chat with us about our operations, careers and opportunities at Cameco.
